name: Dave North
prior_offices: Natrona County commissioner (won the November 2024 general election; listed among current officers on the official elected officials page)
background: Dave North is a Natrona County commissioner. He won the November 2024 general election. Oil City News reported that he and Casey Coates were the top two vote-getters in the 2024 Republican primary that decided that election.
